# Hidden AI Instructions Watch

> Free scanner and evidence-only log for web pages that hide text from people but address AI agents.

- Scanner (free Apify Actor and MCP tool `hidden_ai_instructions_scanner` in panda-web-security-tools): https://apify.com/pandadad0214/hidden-ai-instructions-scanner
- Public log and method: https://github.com/pandadad0214/hidden-ai-instructions-watch
- This Pages site: https://pandadad0214.github.io/hidden-ai-instructions-watch/

This page exposes read-only WebMCP tools: list_tools, get_links, get_project_overview. Catalog: webmcp-catalog.json
- X: https://x.com/PandaFedHQ  (Follow on X: @PandaFedHQ)
